title: Smart Home Project Manager [AI & Automation]
description:
Location: Remote, India (flexible hours with U.S. team overlap)

Engagement type: Full-time

Compensation: INR 2,38,250 - INR 2,85,900 per month (based on experience and interview process)

**About Sanctuary**
-------------------

Sanctuary builds nature - led, wellness - centered communities that feel alive. Our first 135-acre residential community in the Texas Hill Country is designed with:

Non-toxic materials

Clean water and filtration systems

EMF-conscious design

135 acres of preserved land and eco - sensitive planning

We are a global team (spread across 8 countries) of designers, architects, engineers, and dreamers building spaces that restore and inspire. For us, it’s not just where people live - it’s how they live.

Our vision is to bring Sanctuary to major cities around the world: healthy, sovereign communities that sit on the edges of every modern metropolis.

**About the role**
------------------

We are hiring a Smart Home Project Manager to bring technology into our homes in a way that supports how people live. You will manage the implementation of smart home systems across our projects - from planning and vendor selection through installation and handover - and use AI tools to prototype integrations, automate workflows, and build internal systems. Internally, we call this role a "Smart Home VibeKid": someone who can vibe code a working prototype instead of waiting for someone else to build it.

Smart home at Sanctuary looks a little different. Our homes are designed around wellness, so technology has to serve health and comfort - lighting, air and water quality, energy, security - while staying mindful of EMF exposure. You will help decide what goes into our homes, how it all works together, and how residents experience it.

This is not a role for someone who needs close oversight or a fixed playbook. We are looking for someone curious and hands-on, who can test ideas quickly, figure out what's missing, and turn a concept into a working system.

**What you'll do**
------------------

*Smart home implementation*

* Plan and manage smart home technology across our projects: lighting, climate, air and water quality monitoring, energy, security, and connectivity
* Evaluate and select smart home platforms, devices, and vendors that fit our wellness and EMF-conscious standards
* Work with architects, MEP consultants, and the construction team to build smart home systems into designs early
* Oversee installation, testing, and handover with vendors and integrators

*AI prototyping and automation*

* Use AI tools to prototype smart home integrations and automations before they go into homes
* Build internal systems and workflows using AI-assisted ("vibe") coding and no-code platforms
* Automate project tracking, vendor coordination, and reporting for smart home work
* Keep up with new smart home and AI technology, and test what could work for us

*Project management and coordination*

* Track timelines, budgets, and deliverables for smart home scope on each project
* Coordinate vendors, integrators, and internal teams across India and the U.S.
* Document systems clearly for residents, facility management, and future projects

**What you bring**
------------------

* 3-7 years of experience in smart home, home automation, IoT, ELV, or building management systems (BMS) in real estate projects
* Hands-on knowledge of smart home platforms and protocols (e.g. Home Assistant, Control4, Crestron, KNX, Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter)
* Experience managing installations with vendors and integrators, from planning to handover
* Hands-on experience building prototypes or automations with AI (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Replit) or no-code platforms (e.g. Zapier, Make, Airtable)
* Examples of integrations, tools, or automations you've built - please share them when you apply
* Interest in wellness technology (air and water quality, circadian lighting, low-EMF design) is a strong plus
* Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving, remote, cross-cultural environment
* Clear, proactive communicator in English, both written and spoken

**Hiring process**
------------------

* **Stage 1: Intro interview** - Role alignment, experience overview, a walkthrough of systems or tools you've built, and culture fit
* **Stage 2: Test task** - A short practical assignment: plan or prototype a smart home solution using AI tools
* **Stage 3: Final interview** - Deep dive into workflows, expectations, and growth

Our paid media and ABM programs generate a steady stream of creative work — ad concepts, static and video assets, landing pages, ABM personalization, reporting dashboards. Delivering that at scale, to a US client's expectations, is an operations problem. This role owns it.

**Role Summary**
----------------

You are accountable for the entire paid media and creative operations layer: intake, scoping, scheduling, capacity, SLAs, QC and delivery across the portfolio. Account managers own the client relationship and strategy; you own that what we committed gets built correctly and ships on time.

This is a run-the-system-and-make-it-better role. You've managed delivery at scale before, you know what a healthy ClickUp board looks like, and you don't wait for a miss to find out a process is broken.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

### **Project management across the portfolio**

* Own intake to delivery for every paid media, ABM and creative request across ~15 accounts: scoping, briefs, estimates, scheduling, dependencies and sign-off.
* Run the weekly delivery rhythm — sprint planning, daily stand-ups with pods and creative, and a Friday portfolio review of what shipped, what slipped and why.
* Maintain a single, current view of every account's open work, due dates and blockers that an account manager or founder can read in 30 seconds.

### **SLAs and quality control**

* Define and enforce SLAs by deliverable type (ad copy, statics, video, landing pages, dashboards, campaign builds) and report adherence weekly.
* Build and run the QC layer: checklists, review gates and sign-off before anything reaches a client. Brand, copy, spec, tracking and link checks are non-negotiable.
* Track rework and client-reported misses as a defect rate, root-cause them and close the loop with the function that caused them.

### **Creative operations**

* Own the creative pipeline end to end: briefing standards, asset specs per channel (Google, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, CTV), versioning, approvals and asset handoff to paid media.
* Balance load across copy, design, video and web/dev; forecast creative demand from the media plan and staff or reprioritise ahead of the crunch.
* Maintain the creative library, naming conventions and templates so nothing ships off-brand or off-spec.

### **Capacity planning and ClickUp hygiene**

* ClickUp is the source of truth and you keep it that way: every task scoped, owned, estimated, dated and in the right status. No work outside the system.
* Run capacity planning per pod and per function against the retainer scope; flag over-servicing and under-utilisation to leadership monthly.
* Own time-tracking discipline and the utilisation and SLA dashboards leadership uses to run the BU.

### **Client communication**

* Be the delivery voice on client accounts alongside the account manager: status updates, timelines, revision rounds and expectation-setting on what ships when.
* Handle client-facing delivery escalations directly and proactively — before the client raises them.

### **Cross-functional problem solving**

* Sit between account management, paid media pods, copy, design, dev and analytics. When something is stuck, you unblock it, and you fix the process so it doesn't stick again.
* Document and improve SOPs for recurring work; bring AI and automation (ClickUp automations, n8n, Claude) into intake, QC and reporting to cut manual effort.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

Delivery is under control when the client never has to ask where something is.

KPI

Target

What it measures

  

On-time delivery

95%+ of deliverables shipped by committed date

Scheduling and dependency control across the portfolio

  

SLA adherence

95%+ by deliverable type, reported weekly

Turnaround commitments kept per account

  

QC pass rate

98%+ first-pass; zero client-reported brand, spec or tracking errors

Quality gates working before work reaches the client

  

Rework rate

Under 10% of creative deliverables needing a second revision round

Briefing quality and QC discipline

  

ClickUp hygiene

100% of active work scoped, owned, estimated and dated; weekly audit score

The system reflects reality

  

Capacity utilisation

Pods and creative functions within 90–95% planned utilisation; over-servicing flagged monthly

Retainer scope matched to effort

  

Client delivery satisfaction

4.5+ / 5 on delivery and communication in QBR feedback

Clients trust the process, not just the people

  

Process improvement

At least one SOP or automation shipped per month with measured time saved

The system gets better, not just maintained

Targets are reviewed quarterly with the Head of Paid Media and feed the BU's business review.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Non-negotiables**

* 5–8 years in project, delivery or operations management, with at least 3 years running delivery at scale — 10+ concurrent client accounts or 50+ live deliverables a month — at a marketing agency, creative studio or SaaS marketing team.
* A recognized PM certification: PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, CSM/PSM or equivalent. Google Project Management or ClickUp certifications are a plus on top, not a substitute.
* Expert in ClickUp or an equivalent (Asana, Monday, Jira) — you've designed the workspace, the custom fields, the automations and the dashboards, not just used them.
* Hands-on experience running creative operations: briefing, asset specs across paid channels, review and approval cycles, and managing designers, copywriters and video editors' load.
* Working knowledge of paid media and ABM delivery — what a campaign build, a landing page or a reporting dashboard needs before it can ship — enough to QC it and estimate it.
* Accountability as a reflex. You have owned delivery outcomes personally, carried the miss, and fixed the process after.
* Clear, direct written and spoken English; you write client status updates and run calls with US stakeholders.
* Comfortable with US-overlap hours (2:00–11:00 PM IST) and a fully remote, cross-functional team.

### **Strong plusses**

* Six Sigma, Lean or ITIL exposure; you think in defect rates and cycle times.
* Experience with capacity planning and utilisation reporting against retainer scopes.
* Familiarity with Figma, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, GA4 and Looker Studio.
* Experience building ClickUp or n8n automations, or using Claude/ChatGPT to speed up intake, QC and reporting.
* Prior ownership of SOP libraries, onboarding playbooks or delivery handbooks.

### **How you work**

You are organized to the point of being predictable, and the team relies on that. You communicate early, especially bad news. You solve the problem in front of you and then remove the cause. You hold a standard without needing to be the loudest person on the call.

**Why join us**
---------------

* **Own the whole system.** Paid media and creative operations across the portfolio report into you — not a slice of one account.
* **Scale that matters.** 15 accounts, six delivery pods and a creative team shipping for US SaaS brands scaling to $100M+ ARR.
* **Build with AI.** We use Claude, n8n and ClickUp automations in delivery today; you'll have the mandate and budget to push that further.
* **A direct line to leadership.** You report to the Co-Founder running the BU; your dashboards are the ones the business is run on.
* **A clear path.** This role grows into Head of Delivery / Operations as the BU scales.

**Working setup and benefits**
------------------------------

* Fully remote. Work from anywhere in India.
* Fixed US-overlap shift: 2:00–11:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday, so you cover the India afternoon handoff and the full US morning.
* Learning and development budget — PM and platform certifications, courses and conferences.
* Full access to TripleDart's AI-native tooling stack (Claude, ChatGPT, ClickUp, n8n and internal platforms).
* Health insurance and wellbeing support [confirm plan details with HR].

----------------

description:
**Company Introduction**



We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did I ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we're collectively disrupting the multi\-billion\-dollar e\-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest\-growing e\-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.



We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.



Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world.


**Role Overview**



The Coupang Intelligent Cloud (CIC) organization is building the next\-generation cloud platform that powers Coupang's rapidly expanding business. CIC provides the foundational infrastructure, cloud services, platform capabilities, and operational excellence that enable engineering teams across the company to innovate at scale.



As a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, you will drive large\-scale, cross\-functional initiatives spanning cloud infrastructure, compute, networking, storage, AI infrastructure, platform services, operational excellence, reliability, capacity management, and cloud business growth. You will partner closely with engineering leaders, principal engineers, product leaders, finance, security, and operations teams to define strategy, build execution plans, and deliver business\-critical outcomes.



This role requires a unique combination of technical depth, organizational leadership, operational rigor, and strategic thinking. You will lead complex programs that influence the direction of CIC, establish scalable operating mechanisms, and ensure alignment across multiple organizations. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership while driving execution with urgency and accountability.



The ideal candidate can speak the language of engineers, understand large\-scale distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, influence without authority, and navigate ambiguity while delivering measurable results.


**What You Will Do**


* Lead strategic, organization\-wide programs across cloud infrastructure, platform services, AI infrastructure, reliability, security, and operational excellence.
* Define program strategies, success metrics, execution frameworks, and operating mechanisms that scale across the CIC organization.
* Partner with engineering leaders and principal engineers to prioritize investments, manage dependencies, and accelerate delivery of critical initiatives.
* Drive large\-scale platform transformations involving architecture modernization, reliability improvements, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Establish governance mechanisms, executive reviews, risk management processes, and business reporting frameworks.
* Identify organizational bottlenecks, process inefficiencies, and system gaps, and implement scalable solutions to improve execution.
* Lead initiatives involving infrastructure scalability, cloud adoption, capacity planning, service availability, and operational readiness.
* Analyze complex technical and business data to drive prioritization, decision\-making, and resource allocation.
* Define and track organizational KPIs, operational health metrics, reliability goals, and business outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships across engineering, product, security, finance, procurement, and business teams to achieve company objectives.
* Drive executive\-level communications, presenting program status, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Mentor TPMs and contribute to the growth of program management excellence within CIC.


**Basic Qualifications**


* 12\+ years of experience leading large\-scale technical programs in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, enterprise platforms, or related technology domains.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, networking, storage, compute platforms, and modern software development practices.
* Experience driving programs across the full software development lifecycle, from concept through deployment and operational support.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage metrics and data to influence decisions and measure outcomes.
* Experience identifying root causes, managing risks, and solving complex organizational and technical challenges.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience working in hyperscale cloud, infrastructure, platform engineering, AI infrastructure, or large\-scale distributed systems environments.
* Strong technical understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, cloud\-native architectures, and infrastructure automation.
* Experience managing cloud infrastructure programs involving compute, networking, storage, observability, security, or AI/ML platforms.
* Experience partnering with Principal Engineers and senior technical leaders to drive architecture and platform transformation initiatives.

Hybrid /Onsite / Remote working


* Our Hybrid work model: Coupang hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration that acts a catalyst to enrich the experience of employees. Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work.
